sections.text: مقدمة

This pump is used to transfer the coolant water 
from Nile River to condenser for condensing the steam from turbine to condensate 
water. This document outlines the major maintenance which must be performed 
every 5 Years as indicated by Y5 in above title block.

The first draft 
initiated by Eng. Mahmoud Abou
الفتوح Shata Tested By 
Eng. Ali Abd Elslam 
,and revised by MDEPC quality control engineer 
Abouda Elbana ,accepted by General Director 
Eng. Yosry عبد Elmaqsood, 
ووافق عليها ENG. فاروق Awad رئيس قطاع
طلخا Power Station . This document accepted by 
Eng. Samer Abd El-Gilil 
MDEPC inspection & quality control General Director MPIS coordinator & certified 
by Eng. Mohamed Nageb MDEPC inspection and quality 
control Head Sector inspection

sections.text: Remove suction case plug from bottom of suction case.

Slide suction case over the lower end of the pump 
shaft ,suction case bearing will slide off with the suction case.

Loosen set screw on suction case sand collar and 
slide sand collar and grease sea lover lower end of pump shaft.

Use driver tool to drive impeller lock cullet toward 
top of bowl assembly .
Slide impeller over lower end of pump shaft.

Place blade of screw driver in the split on the 
cullet end slide the cullet over lower end of pump shaft .
Remove bolts from bowl flange .
Slide وعاء الضخ على الطرف السفلي من عمود المضخة.

Repeat step (5) through (6) to remove remainder of 
bowls when top bowl is removed top bowl bearing and seal if used , will slide 
off with the bowl.

.

Assembly refer to 
fig no ( 1)

Sطاقم the positioning plug into the lower end 
of the suction case and lay I horizontal position .

Insert shaft fully into suction case and lock against positioning plug by 
tightening3/8bolt on the positioning plug.

Slide the 
grease seal dawn the shaft with the lip of the seal pointing away from bottom of 
the pump seat it firmly and evenly in the recessed housing at the top of the 
suction case .

Slide the 
sand culler down the shaft and turn it back and forth until it fits fully down 
over the suction case bearing housing then tighten set screw 
.

شريحة 
تقوم المكره بأسفل عمود المضخة حتى تستقر في التجويف الموجود أعلى الشفط
case .

مكان المسمار 
شفرة المحرك منقسمة في مكسارة المكره ثم قم بتحريك المكسارة إلى أسفل العمود حتى تصل إلى ذلك 
تقع في impeller ,work the cullet by hand as far 
into the impeller or as possible.

استخدم 
سائق قفل المكره لقيادة المطحنة بشكل آمن بين المكره 
ومضخة shaft .

يزيل cullet driver from shaft and slide bowl 
down shaft until it mates with the top of the suction case.

بدوره المضخة 
الوعاء حتى يتماشى التضليع على الوعاء مع التضليع عند الشفط 
case .

Insert and 
uniformly tighten البراغي.
Repeat step (5) &(8) until all bowls are in place.

قم بتحريك علبة التفريغ (16)down the shaft slowly until it 
mates with the top bowl .

Insert and uniformly tighten bolts remove 3/8 bolt from bottom of positioning 
plug and screw grease fitting into the hole and inject a good grade of insoluble 
grease.
Work shaft up and down several times to remove excess grease.
Remove the positioning plug and insert the suction case plug .

After bowl assembly is completely reason-pled measure end play of shaft and 
compare against reading obtained after step nominal end play dimensions .
